incorporated_articles.title: 9. Create a secure service which protects users’ privacy

units.text: If you use AI technology in your service, you must do so in ways that: are safe for users and protect their data; are as environmentally sustainable as possible; keep your service secure.
units.text_start: you must do so in ways that

units.text: Services using AI need to meet the same standards as services using other technology.
units.text_start: Services using AI need to meet the same standards

units.text: More established technologies might solve the problem better than AI. Only use AI where there is clear evidence of a user need.
units.text_start: More established technologies might solve the problem better than AI
units.text_end: Only use AI where there is clear evidence of a user need

units.section: Tell users when AI is being used
units.text: if you use AI in your service, you must make it clear to users how this might affect: their data; the outcome or information they receive from the service
units.text_start: you must make it clear to users how this might affect
units.text_end: the outcome or information they receive from the service

units.section: Tell users when AI is being used
units.text: If you use an AI-powered chatbot, you must make sure users: understand that the answers they receive do not come from a human and might not be accurate; know how to contact a human being.
units.text_start: understand that the answers they receive do not come from a human
units.text_end: know how to contact a human being

units.section: Make sure your service is accurate
units.text: You must make sure that users: receive accurate information; are protected from bias.

units.section: Make sure your service is accurate
units.text: Your service owner must understand the technology being used, the risks of using it and how to mitigate these. Someone on your team must be able to explain your service’s use of AI.
units.text_start: Your service owner must understand the technology being used
units.text_end: explain your service’s use of AI

units.text: You must consult a security professional to make sure that: users’ data is protected; your service stays secure.
units.text_start: You must consult a security professional

units.text: it’s particularly important to keep monitoring and iterating services that use AI technology throughout their lifecycle. You should be prepared to stop using AI technology in your service if needed.
units.text_start: keep monitoring and iterating services that use AI technology
units.text_end: stop using AI technology in your service if needed

units.section: 9. Create a secure service which protects users’ privacy
units.text: Service teams must follow the Secure By Design principles and: perform due diligence on the security of third-party software; perform user research to create security processes that are fit for purpose and easy to understand; collect, process and store data securely and in a way which respects users’ privacy.
units.text_start: Service teams must follow the Secure By Design principles
